chunks: Aḥmad ibn Mihrān, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī, from Saʿīd ibn Abī al-Jahm, from al-Naṣr ibn Qābūs, who said:

I said to Abū Ibrāhīm (عليه السلام), “I had asked your father (عليه السلام) who it is that will be after you, and he informed me that it is you. Then when Abū ʿAbdillāh (عليه السلام) passed away, the people went right and left, while I and my companions held to you. So inform me who it is that will be after you from among your children.” He said, “My son, so-and-so.”

key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abū ʿAbdillāh, the earlier Imam whose passing is mentioned
key_terms.أَبِي إِبْرَاهِيمَ: Abū Ibrāhīm, the Imam being addressed in the narration
key_terms.ابْنِي فُلَانٌ: my son, so-and-so; an expression of identifying the succeeding son
key_terms.ذَهَبَ النَّاسُ يَمِينًا وَشِمَالًا: the people split and dispersed in different directions after the Imam’s death
key_terms.مِنْ بَعْدِكَ: after you; referring to succession following the Imam
key_terms.وُلْدِكَ: your children; indicating inquiry about succession among the Imam’s sons

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith indicate succession in the line of the Imams after Abū ʿAbdillāh and Abū Ibrāhīm (عليهما السلام)?
ai.summary: This hadith records a report about the designation of the Imam after Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq (عليه السلام) and then asks about the successor after Abū Ibrāhīm (عليه السلام). It reflects the concern of the companions regarding continuity of the Imamate and the recognition of the divinely appointed successor within the Ahl al-Bayt (عليهم السلام).

en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Mihran, from Muhammad Bin Ali, from Saeed Bin Abu Al Jahm, from Al Nasr Bin Qabous who said,

‘I said to Abu Ibrahim<sup>asws</sup> (7<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>), ‘I asked your<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> who is that who would happen to be from after you<sup>asws</sup>. So he<sup>asws</sup> informed me that you<sup>asws</sup> are him<sup>asws</sup>. So when Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> passed away, the people went right and left, and I said regarding you<sup>asws</sup>, I and my companions. Therefore, inform me, who is the one who would happen to be from after you<sup>asws</sup> from your<sup>asws</sup> sons?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘My<sup>asws</sup> son, so and so’.
en.sarwar: 12. Ahmad ibn Mihran has narrated from Muhammad ibn Ali from Sa‘id ibn abu al-Jahm from al-Nasr ibn Qabus who has said the following.

“I said to abu Ibrahim (a.s.), ‘I asked your father, “Who will be (the Imam) after you? He informed me that you will be (the Imam after him). When abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) left this world people went let and right and I said that I with my people are with you. Inform me who will be (the Imam) after you from your sons.” He (the Imam (a.s.) said, “My son so and so.”
